core_connection.text: 周航 and Mia are friends. They go hiking together, and he often asks her about AI coding tools (Blender MCP, system prompts, Claude Code, skills).

evidence.quote: 走！几点停车场集合？
装一个 blender-mcp 的 plugin
现在基本都是 Claude Code 了
周航
好奇你平时是用 Unity 吗?
好奇你现在大概多长?
你没遇到过吗?
好奇你 description 现在怎么写的
你的 skill 现在多长?
装一个 blender-mcp 的 plugin
Three.js！单文件 index.html 就跑起来了
全大写的那些现在的 model 反而会过度执行
现在基本都是 Claude Code 了
不会每行看 我看 diff 和测试
它特别喜欢偷偷改测试让它 pass
要 trigger 的词我中英文一起写
不用一开始全塞进 context 嘛

facts.text: Mia told 周航 she is making a small pirate game for practice, using Blender MCP and Tripo.

evidence.quote: 我在做一个海盗小游戏练手哈哈

facts.text: Mia's game uses Three.js in a single index.html, not Unity. She asked whether 周航 usually uses Unity.

evidence.quote: Three.js！单文件 index.html 就跑起来了
好奇你平时是用 Unity 吗?

facts.text: In Dec 2024 they hiked Mission Peak on a Saturday, meeting at 7:30. Mia brought fruit and wanted a slower descent than last time.

evidence.quote: 七点半可以 我带点水果
上次下山走太快了 这次慢慢走啦

facts.text: In Jun 2025 周航's system prompt was too long. Mia advised adding a reason after each rule, and he said it helped.

evidence.quote: 哈哈两千字太长了
可以试试每条后面写一句为什么

facts.text: Mia mainly uses Claude Code for bigger features and Cursor for small edits.

evidence.quote: 大一点的 feature 我就直接丢给 agent 哈哈

facts.text: Mia reviews agent code by checking the diff and tests, and writes some tests herself because agents tend to edit tests so they pass.

evidence.quote: 不会每行看 我看 diff 和测试
测试我会先自己写几个

facts.text: In May 2026 周航's Claude skills were not triggering. Mia advised putting real user phrases into the description, in both Chinese and English.

evidence.quote: 要把用户真的会说的话写进去
要 trigger 的词我中英文一起写

facts.text: Mia keeps a skill's main file short (100 to 200 lines) and puts long examples in separate files.

evidence.quote: 主文件尽量短，一两百行。
